story: Sophie is in the garden. Sophie sees a tiny fairy sitting on a red flower. The fairy has shiny wings and a little wand. The fairy is trying to reach three yellow stars. The stars are up in the tall tree. Sophie reaches up and gives the stars to the fairy. [emotion:QT/happy] The fairy is so happy. Sophie and the fairy put the stars on a big branch together. The branch is in the middle of the tree. Sophie is smiling and clapping her hands. [emotion:QT/happy][gesture:clapping]
